profile.subject: a cream golden retriever dog
profile.styleHints: Creamy white long fur, floppy ears, black nose, pink tongue out, feathery tail

cycle.prompt: Same cream golden retriever dog in strict side profile facing right, one dark eye visible, 4-frame trot walk cycle with legs alternating, fluffy tail wagging slightly, pink tongue out, same size in every frame, 4 equal columns with wide magenta gaps, plain white background, cute kids style

profile.idlePrompt: Pose: standing alert in side view facing right, four paws planted, head up, mouth open with tongue out panting, tail relaxed

rest.label: Sit and rest
rest.prompt: Pose: sitting calmly with front legs straight, hind legs folded, head up, tongue out panting happily, feathery tail curled around paws

sleep.label: Sleep curled
sleep.prompt: Pose: curled up on side with paws tucked, head resting on paws, eyes closed, fluffy tail over nose, peacefully sleeping

voice.label: Happy bark
voice.prompt: Pose: standing with head raised, mouth open wide barking, ears perked, tail wagging up, chest forward

trick.label: Shake a paw
trick.prompt: Pose: sitting and lifting one front paw up high to shake, head tilted, mouth open smiling, tail wagging fast

lines: Hi, I'm Pakkun, let's be friends!
I love sunny grassy days so much
See my happy smile? It's for you
I'm your big fluffy best buddy
Stay close, I'll keep you happy

facts.text: They have a soft light cream coat that looks almost white.
They are friendly, gentle dogs and great friends for kids.
They are smart, love to learn, and need daily play and walks.
